title: Pair Sum in a Sorted Array
statement_md: Given an array `nums` sorted in non-decreasing order and an integer `target`, return `true` if two different positions hold values that sum to `target`, and `false` otherwise.
constraints: nums is sorted in non-decreasing order

tests.explain_on_fail: An empty array has no pairs.
Equal values at two different positions still form a pair.
A single element cannot pair with itself.

hints.body_md: The array is sorted. What happens to the sum when you move the left end right, or the right end left?
Start one pointer at each end. Too small: advance the left one. Too big: retreat the right one.
